aka.zh: 福州—兰州公路（福兰线，1981 年线路）

tagline.en: From the Fujian coast at Changle to Tongren on the Tibetan plateau's edge, by Nanchang, Wuhan, Xiangyang and the Han valley
tagline.zh: 从福建长乐海岸到青藏高原边缘的同仁，途经南昌、武汉、襄阳和汉江谷地

start.zh: 福建省福州市长乐区漳港

end.en: Tongren, Huangnan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai
end.zh: 青海省黄南藏族自治州同仁市

en: G316 crosses China from the south-east coast to the north-west through Fujian, Jiangxi, Hubei, Shaanxi, Gansu and Qinghai. From Changle it goes up the Min river by Minqing and Nanping to Shunchang, Shaowu and Guangze, over into Jiangxi at Zixi and on by Jinxi and Fuzhou (the Jiangxi city) to Nanchang. From Nanchang it crosses into Hubei and passes Daye, Huangshi and Ezhou to Wuhan, then runs north-west by Xiaogan, Yunmeng, Anlu, Suizhou and Zaoyang to Xiangyang, Laohekou and Shiyan. In Shaanxi it follows the Han valley by Baihe, Xunyang, Ankang, Hanyin, Shiquan, Xixiang, Chenggu and Hanzhong, then crosses the mountains by Liuba and Feng county into Gansu at Liangdang and Hui county, and climbs by Li county, Min county, Zhuoni, Lintan, Hezuo and Xiahe to Tongren.

The 1981 road ran from Fuzhou to Lanzhou, 2,915 km. The 2013 national highway plan moved its start to Zhanggang on the coast of Changle and its end from Lanzhou to Tongren in Qinghai. The route description in the Chinese encyclopedia entry for the road has it cross the Yangtze at Wuhan on the 1957 Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge. The atlas draws Changle–Tongren as one piece and a short stretch in Gansu separately; this page is anchored on the long piece.
zh: G316 自东南沿海向西北横穿中国，途经福建、江西、湖北、陕西、甘肃、青海。从长乐出发，沿闽江而上经闽清、南平至顺昌、邵武、光泽，翻入江西资溪，经金溪、抚州至南昌。过南昌后进入湖北，经大冶、黄石、鄂州到武汉，再向西北经孝感、云梦、安陆、随州、枣阳至襄阳、老河口、十堰。陕西境内沿汉江谷地经白河、旬阳、安康、汉阴、石泉、西乡、城固、汉中，再经留坝、凤县翻山进入甘肃两当、徽县，经礼县、岷县、卓尼、临潭、合作、夏河爬升至同仁。
1981 年的线路自福州至兰州，全长 2915 公里。《国家公路网规划（2013 年—2030 年）》将起点移至长乐海边的漳港，终点由兰州改为青海同仁。中文百科条目的路线说明称，它在武汉经 1957 年建成的武汉长江大桥跨越长江。图集将长乐至同仁画成一条线段，甘肃境内另有一小段单独绘出；本页定位在长线段上。

en: In Fuzhou the city's local history office lists two bridges of the 1980s as G316's crossings of the Min. The Hongshan Bridge over the northern branch, begun in October 1981 and opened in December 1985, is 363 m long in seven spans with a 110 m main span, a three-way prestressed T-frame. The Hongtang Bridge on the western edge of the city, begun on 15 March 1987, finished at the end of 1990 and in use from January 1991, is 1,849 m long in 48 spans with a 120 m main span; the office calls it the starting section of G316, and Fuzhou News that it joined G316 and G324 in Minhou county. Both have since been replaced as the city widened the road between them to eight lanes: work on a new Hongshan Bridge, 471 m long with a 132 m main span, began in June 2016, and the main line of the new Hongtang Bridge, a single-tower self-anchored suspension bridge 2.2 km long, opened on the evening of 21 April 2021.

The coastal extension is a different kind of road. The Changle Zhanggang–Yingqian section, 15.578 km, is an eight-lane class-I highway designed for 80 km/h that doubles as an urban expressway, joining the Daoqingzhou bridge to the new coastal town. Its Dongfengshan tunnel group has four parallel bores totalling 8,197 m, excavated more than 20 m wide and over 230 square metres in section; the Changle government described it as the largest-span urban tunnel group under construction in China. Builders said the shallow, broken ground under the national forest park behaved 'like soft tofu', and that less than 500 m of cut-and-cover and shallow tunnel took them three years.
zh: 福州市地方志机构列出了两座 20 世纪 80 年代建成、承载 316 国道跨越闽江的大桥。跨闽江北港的洪山大桥 1981 年 10 月动工，1985 年 12 月建成通车，全长 363 米，7 孔，主孔跨径 110 米，为三向预应力衍架 T 梁钢构。城市西郊的洪塘大桥 1987 年 3 月 15 日动工，1990 年底建成，1991 年 1 月投入使用，全长 1849 米，48 孔，主孔跨径 120 米；该机构称之为 316 国道线的起点段，福州新闻网则称它把国道 316 线和 324 线在闽侯境内连接贯通。此后福州将两桥之间的道路拓宽为双向八车道，两座桥都已重建：新洪山大桥全长 471 米，最大跨度 132 米，2016 年 6 月开工；新洪塘大桥为独塔式双索面自锚式悬索桥，长 2.2 公里，主线于 2021 年 4 月 21 日晚启用。

沿海延伸段是另一种路。长乐漳港至营前段全长 15.578 公里，按双向八车道一级公路、设计时速 80 公里建设，兼具城市快速路功能，与道庆洲大桥顺接，通往滨海新城。控制性工程董奉山隧道左右、主辅四洞并行，累计长 8197 米，开挖最大净宽超过 20 米、断面 230 多平方米；长乐区政府称之为全国在建最大跨度城市隧道群。建设者说，国家森林公园下浅埋破碎的地层“犹如一块水豆腐”，穿越不到 500 米的明洞及浅埋段就耗费了 3 年。

en: G316 was one of the east–west routes of the national trunk highway plan issued in November 1981, which numbered them in the 300s. In Fuzhou the city was building the road's river crossings at the same time: the Hongshan Bridge was begun the month before the plan appeared. The 2013 plan's extension to the coast began to be built when work on the Changle section started on 15 January 2020; its main carriageway opened at noon on 29 December 2023, toll-free, cutting the drive from the Strait International Convention Centre to the coastal town to about 20 minutes, 25 minutes less than by the airport expressway.
zh: 1981 年 11 月发布的《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》中，G316 是以“3”开头编号的东西横线之一。福州当时也正在修建这条路的过江桥梁：洪山大桥就在方案发布前一个月动工。2013 年规划中的沿海延伸段，随 2020 年 1 月 15 日长乐段开工而开始建设；主路于 2023 年 12 月 29 日中午 12 时通车，免收通行费，从会展中心林浦互通到滨海新城约 20 分钟，比走机场高速缩短 25 分钟。

en: No cost exists for the route as a whole. The one large recent work whose price is published is the Changle Zhanggang–Yingqian section: 10.157 billion yuan in approved budget for 15.578 km, about 650 million yuan a kilometre; one 3.79 km contract, which includes part of the Dongfengshan tunnel, alone was worth about 1.169 billion.
zh: 全线没有总造价。近年唯一公布了造价的大型工程是长乐漳港至营前段：全长 15.578 公里，概算总投资 101.57 亿元，每公里约 6.5 亿元；其中一个包含董奉山隧道部分区段的 3.79 公里合同段，投资就约 11.69 亿元。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole road, which links older roads across six provinces and is rebuilt section by section, each priced on its own. Sourced section costs are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：它连接六个省份原有的道路，分段改建、分段计价。下列为有来源的路段造价。

why.en: No funding statement has been found for the route or for any section, including the Changle section; the sources give only its budget.
why.zh: 未查到全线或任何路段（包括长乐段）的出资说明；资料只给出了概算。

value.en: 2,915 km, Fuzhou–Lanzhou. No length has been found for the 2013 Changle–Tongren route.
value.zh: 福州至兰州 2915 公里。未查到 2013 年长乐至同仁线路的里程。

timeline.en: Work on the Hongshan Bridge in Fuzhou begins in October; the national trunk highway plan of November names Fuzhou–Lanzhou as G316.
timeline.zh: 10 月，福州洪山大桥动工；11 月，《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》将福州至兰州公路编为 316 国道。

timeline.en: The Hongshan Bridge opens in December.
Work on the Hongtang Bridge begins on 15 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 15 日，洪塘大桥动工。

timeline.en: The Hongtang Bridge comes into use in January.
The national highway plan moves the ends to Changle and to Tongren in Qinghai.
timeline.zh: 国家公路网规划将起讫点改为长乐与青海同仁。

timeline.en: Work on a new Hongshan Bridge begins in June.
Work on the Changle Zhanggang–Yingqian section begins on 15 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 15 日，长乐漳港至营前段开工。

timeline.en: The main line of the new Hongtang Bridge opens on 21 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 21 日，新洪塘大桥主线启用。

timeline.en: The Changle section's main carriageway opens on 29 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 29 日，长乐漳港至营前段主路通车。
